fields.name: challengeId
fields.description: Random 24-character id handed to the caller.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Portal user who started the link.

fields.name: nonce
fields.description: OIDC nonce the ID token must carry (google / microsoft). Never readable by browser users.

fields.name: codeHash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the mailed code (email-code). Never readable by browser users.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: UTC creation time (rate limit: 5 starts per 15 minutes per user).

fields.name: usedAt
fields.description: Set once the challenge is used up (success, failed sign-in, or last wrong code).

fields.name: codeMailed
fields.description: True when a 6-digit code was mailed to the address (written for audit).

fields.name: verified
fields.description: True when the challenge was successfully completed (written for audit).
